_about: Cook's scene data (R4, decision 24), in the design's own units (1600x900, D15). views[<view>].safe = [x0, y0, x1, y1]: what the child must reach in that Cook view (every tappable thing and shelf chip, measured with build/measure_cook_views.mjs at level 4, plus a margin). js/cook/frame-hookup.js hands it to the shared stage (js/shared/stage.js), so on a tablet that view grows up to data/layout.json stage.itemScale, cropping only what lies outside. A view not listed keeps the whole box (stage.scenes.cook). data/layout.json's stage.scenes["cook:<view>"] wins over this file.

views._about: Empty for now (R4): every Cook view keeps the whole box. Measured (build/measure_cook_views.mjs, level 4) the marble worktop's tappables span x 90-1394, but its stations keep the bottom-right corner clear for the Done tick (x 1410-1600), and the pantry's fridge holds things at x 1482: any narrower area puts a shelf chip under the tick or off screen (sandbox r4-final: cook:assemble@L4 at 1024x768, cook:day1 and day3). Growing play items on 4:3 tablets needs each station laid out for 4:3 first (the shelf in two rows or a narrower pitch, the tick's corner kept).
